scope: Approved read-only Slack channel and observed-reply capture; DMs excluded
sourceChange: The ordinary platform tick may make one additional serial Slack worker call after a successful page and a 31-second wait, only when its local time budget permits. Existing database claims, 30-second internal-app cooldown, workspace lease, request reservations and provider Retry-After remain authoritative.

validation.offlineCompiledWorkerProbe: TEST and LIVE candidate bundles loaded, respected filtered-input isolation and completed a synthetic empty tick with network disabled, no real credentials and no provider calls.
validation.binaryReproductionLimit: Rebundling the management-downloaded transpiled LIVE source did not reproduce the prior ESZIP byte for byte. The exact deployed original ESZIP was downloaded and retained privately for rollback; all staged source files except the one intended module matched the downloaded source.

test.reason: TEST lacks the LIVE serviceos-worker cron history and does not mirror the LIVE internal-rate profile; its release proves exact artifact and runtime smoke, not production throughput.

live.normalSlackJobs: History/reply jobs continued to succeed at approximately one per minute in the initial observation.

interpretation: The narrow release is healthy but has not raised sustained throughput. Most observed pages took roughly 13-16 seconds, beyond the conservative first-call threshold for a second attempt. Initial reply discovery is still generating work faster than it settles. A new capacity design must be separately rehearsed and measured; do not call the 160-channel handoff complete.
rollback: Private exact TEST and LIVE original ESZIP artifacts and guarded release journals are retained; rollback must verify the current version and candidate hash first.
